metadata.title: Tesla Stock Drops. Cybercab Hype Is Out of Control. <!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Tesla Stock Drops. Cybercab Hype Is Out of Control.
Tesla stock started the week with a bang, rising 5.5% on Monday. Investors’ optimism wasn’t easy to explain. The likeliest reason, according to Future Fund co-founder Gary Black, was robo-taxis. Investors are getting more excited about a potential introduction of Tesla’s Cybercab into its fleet of self-driving cabs.
